hooks.commandWindows: $ONMHJ_ROOT = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:ONMHJ_ROOT) { $env:ONMHJ_ROOT } else { '' }; if (-not $ONMHJ_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $node = (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if ($node) { & $node (Join-Path $ONMHJ_ROOT 'bin\onmhj.js') hook SessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec -- node (Join-Path $ONMHJ_ROOT 'bin\onmhj.js') hook SessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0

$ONMHJ_ROOT = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:ONMHJ_ROOT) { $env:ONMHJ_ROOT } else { '' }; if (-not $ONMHJ_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $node = (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if ($node) { & $node (Join-Path $ONMHJ_ROOT 'bin\onmhj.js') hook UserPromptSubmit; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec -- node (Join-Path $ONMHJ_ROOT 'bin\onmhj.js') hook UserPromptSubmit; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0
